Novhorod-Siverskyi connected Desna settlements and routes. Princes, church and inhabitants relied on surrounding production. Travelers needed the correct town and route, while acquaintances, envoys and kin carried news between places. Guards arranged watches, messages and entry checks; pursuit reduced defenders. Escorts needed closing times, waiting places and arrangements for injured mounts and cargo.
